desktopApps.moreItems: Native approval dialog for an agent's desktop action. Shown inside the action's arguments where a list has more items than the dialog lists. {{count}} is how many were left out.
desktopApps.cut: Native approval dialog for an agent's desktop action. Shown after a text, address, script or step that was cut short. {{count}} is how many characters were left out.
desktopApps.signedIn: Native approval dialog line under the action sentence. Says the action happens in the person's own web browser, where they are signed in to their accounts.
desktopApps.signedInOn: Native approval dialog line under the action sentence. Same as the previous line, with the website the action goes to. {{origin}} is a web address such as https://www.example.org.

desktopAppsSettings.app: One line in the native confirmation for allowing agents to control an app. {{name}} is the app's display name; {{identity}} is its bundle id on macOS or the full path of its program on Windows and Linux.
desktopAppsSettings.more: Last line of the native confirmation when more changes are listed than fit. {{count}} is how many were left out.

blockedMode.title: Title of a warning in a CLI agent conversation: the agent is in a mode with permission checks off and Oleafly could not switch it. {{mode}} is the agent's own name for that mode, for example Bypass permissions.
blockedMode.description: Text under that warning. Says what the mode allows and where to change it.
